audio_role: Upbeat drum-driven track under the whole reel, no voice. Cuts land about every 1 second on the beat. Kitchen sounds are low under music. Final cross-section hold lets the beat resolve.
can_make: We can make the hook and structure from the edit: black title What makes you Happy?, white this. locked over center, fast 1s cuts on beat, music. We can start from the restaurant's real menu photo of the finished burger and generate 4 s push-in clips, and have the house AI cast hold and present the wrapped burger and the two halves - they hold and show, never eat. We cannot make the true build: gloved hands spreading white sauce, dropping lettuce, squeezing pink sauce with real drip, placing two crispy fillets, draping cheddar, closing, wrapping in paper and knife-cutting to a real juicy cross-section. AI hands warp and crispy crust and sauce flow smear in 4 s clips, so layering would be faked stills and morphs, not real assembly.
core: Answering What makes you Happy? with this. on every layer while a tall double crispy chicken burger is stacked and then cut open.
dish: double crispy fried chicken burger on brioche with white sauce, chopped lettuce, thin deli slice, pink sauce, double cheddar, wrapped in printed paper and cut in half
fits: Tall layered dishes with a readable inside: double burgers, crispy chicken sandwiches, club sandwiches, wraps, burritos, shawarma where stacking height and cross-section sell size.
hook: 0-1s: black screen with big white What popping in, then makes you Happy? stacking word by word - high contrast question with no food yet.
needs_camera: Real hands in black gloves building in continuity on a yellow board in a real kitchen; real sauce viscosity and drip over crispy crust in macro; real cheese bend over chicken; real paper wrap and steel knife cut opening to a hot layered interior held to the lens.
people: hands only in black nitrile gloves, no faces, no talking. Hands slice bun, spread sauce, place lettuce, deli slice, squeeze bottle, place chicken and cheese twice, close with top bun, wrap, cut and hold up halves.

text_on_screen: 0-4.24s: What makes you Happy? in white bold on black. 4.24-21.2s: small white this. centered over every food shot.
why_it_works: Close lens shows white smear, green lettuce, pink sauce running down orange crispy crust, cheese bending over the edge, then height doubling with second fillet. The final cut proves the inside: two thick breaded fillets, melted cheese lines, sauces and bun. No eating, just texture, drip, volume and repetition.
